title: Garlic & Lemon Salmon with Pea Pesto Couscous
steps: Mix mayonnaise with garlic; grate in lemon zest and mix again.
Cover a baking tray with foil; place salmon on top. Smear mayo mixture over tops and sides; season; sprinkle with paprika.
Roast on middle shelf for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, tip couscous into a bowl; cover with hot stock; cover with an upturned plate; leave 10 minutes. Cook frozen peas.
Fluff couscous with a fork; add pesto and drained peas; mix thoroughly.
Divide couscous between plates; place salmon on top; serve with lemon wedges and steamed vegetables.
notes: Add seasonal vegetables (asparagus, leeks, green beans, courgettes, Brussels sprouts) — cook and stir into couscous with the pesto.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
